crossRefs.note: “Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs…
So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until…
They each caught his opponent by the head, and thrust his sword in his fellow’s side; so they fell down together…

people.name: Akeldama
people.line: Field purchased with Judas' betrayal money; burial place for strangers

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: It became known to everyone who lived in Jerusalem that in their language that field was called ‘Akeldama,’ that is, ‘The field of blood.’
translations.bsb: This became known to all who lived in Jerusalem, so they called that field in their own language Akeldama, that is, Field of Blood.)
translations.kjv: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.
translations.asv: And it became known to all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch that in their language that field was called Akeldama, that is, The field of blood.)
